_comment: Illustrations du site sophia-culture.com, produites par scripts/site_art.py (Recraft v3 sur fal.ai). Direction : gravure moderne deux couleurs, bleu marine et safran sur papier crème, formes franches, sans texte. Palette = couleurs de la maquette.

items.name: hero
items.prompt: A curious young person sitting cross-legged, reading on a smartphone, surrounded by floating objects of knowledge: a Greek helmet, a swirling galaxy, an open book, a compass rose, a small Eiffel tower, a laurel branch, a lightning bolt. Bold linocut print, two colors only, deep navy blue and saffron yellow on cream paper, playful balanced composition, clear silhouettes, lots of negative space, no text.
